settings.question: How do I know this isn't another dropship store?
settings.answer: Our stock sits in Dubai Investment Park, which is why every product page shows a delivery date rather than a two-to-four-week range. The photos are shot in our office, so reverse image search finds them nowhere else. And the licence number in the footer is real — 1148392, registered in Dubai.
